svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 453 mm length of 25 x 25 x 2 tube; ends square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: within 0.5 mm (use a mitre box), deburred inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the bottom end. All four holes go through both side walls,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the centre line of one pair of faces (the side faces):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 5.5 mm holes 15 and 40 mm up from the bottom (foot angles);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 5.5 mm holes 45 and 85 mm down from the top (corner plates).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill from one side through both walls in a drill stand so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes run straight; check a bolt passes freely.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The length sets the camera height: 453 mm puts the lens

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 440 mm above the mat with an 18 mm board and 4 mm mat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the board between the foot angles; the arm butts its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front face; the cable runs up its back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: length within 0.5 mm; ends square; four holes line up.
